metadata.title: Theater and Performance - Overview and Landscape
Theater and Performance - Overview and Landscape

sections.text: Theater is the art of live performance before an audience. It is distinct from recorded performance (cinema, television) by its liveness — the irreducible present-tense co-presence of performers and audience. Performance studies expanded this definition to include any behavior that is "performed" in a broader sense — from ritual to political speechmaking to everyday social behavior.
